mapper.select:
select e.* from ecl_execute_record_lib e inner join (select kpi_provision_detail_id, max(version) as version from ecl_execute_record_lib group by kpi_provision_detail_id) t on e.kpi_provision_detail_id = t.kpi_provision_detail_id and e.version = t.version
and e.client_name like concat('%', #{param.clientName},'%')
and e.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode},'%')
and #{param.createTimeFrom} > e.create_time
